name: Stained glass
one_line: Jewel-coloured panes held by dark lead, lit from behind.
look_words: A world made of stained glass with the light behind it. Every surface is a flat pane of coloured glass, emerald, sapphire and violet, separated by thick dark lead lines; there is no shading inside a pane, only slight streaks in the glass. Colours are deep and jewel-like and seem to glow because the background is bright. Amber and aqua panes mark what to collect and where to go, ruby red is harm, and the player is pale clear glass. Shapes are bold and simple, built from a few straight or gently curved cuts. Motion is slow, with light shifting across the panes and coloured light falling on the ground. Avoid gradients, thin lines, small detail, realistic lighting and bloom.

palette.name: stained glass
palette.notes: The dark end is the lead: use it for thick outlines between everything. The kit has no stained-glass look yet, so this starts as flat jewel colours.

look_wish: thick dark outlines and flat glowing fills

upgrade.why: supplies the outlines between shapes; make them thick and near-black for the lead

music.mood: slow choir pads and a small pipe organ

sound_feel: glass chimes, soft taps on glass, a big echoing room
